title: Actual quantum response · evolving versus frozen links
description: Actual Pauli-Y signalling probes after age2 under the full quantum law, with paired Gamma+5% and initially frozen-link controls. These are distinct from the fresh-matter frozen-graph conditional summaries.

chart.label: Full quantum top-two response capture F

uncertainty: Exact finite-state response calculations per preparation, not confidence intervals. E has 12 independent units per cell; symmetric controls one state each. F and gain are descriptive realization values; exact joint decision bounds are in dynamical-primary.
sampleUnit: 168 complete preparations, two registered response delays each. Sources, targets, perturbations and times are dependent within each preparation. Locality capture excludes the source diagonal and preserves fractional ties.
assumptions: Target trace distance measures operational distinguishability, not pre-existing correlation. A source row with no response gives undefined F, never perfect locality. Mean E summaries in the interface are descriptive arithmetic averages only.
selection: All 336 gate.response_details objects from the pinned raw archive, plus exact cell labels and C/L/T/D/joint flags. Full states and individual source-target arrays remain in the source; none are copied into the app.
